title: Bitcoin from Scratch
summary: Bitcoin treated as a system, not a ticker. The 2008 white paper read section by section, proof-of-work as energy-as-truth, the UTXO model and self-custody, the supply schedule and what halvings actually change, why Lightning exists and what it doesn't fix, and Bitcoin as a political artifact as much as a technical one.
learningOutcomes: Read the Bitcoin white paper end to end and explain what each section is doing and why.
Describe proof-of-work in terms of energy expenditure, difficulty adjustment, and the kind of finality it produces.
Explain the UTXO model, contrast it with an account model, and articulate the trade-offs of each.
Describe the supply schedule, what a halving is, and what halvings do and do not change about the system.
Explain why the Lightning Network exists, what it solves, and the costs and limits it introduces.
Defend or critique the claim that Bitcoin is a political object as much as a technical one, and steel-man the side you disagree with.
